clue.text: Smart car proves a brilliant success to a point

parts.note: a coup is a sudden, brilliant stroke of success
E is east, one of the compass points

explanation.surface: A stylish car turns out to be a triumph, up to a point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smart' reads as part of a brand name but simply describes the stylish two-door car being defined.
explanation.definitionFit: A coupe is a sleek two-door saloon, a model often thought of as stylish.

clue.text: Engage staff to win popularity

definitions.meaning: to hire or employ workers
an informal sense: to catch on or become popular

explanation.surface: Hiring people in order to become better liked.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both hiring someone and, informally, catching on with the public.

clue.text: Classified announcements dishearten small lads

indicators.note: to take the heart out of something, here the central letter of the nine-letter phrase

explanation.surface: Newspaper advertisements discourage little boys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dishearten' removes the middle letter, the third L, of SMALLLADS.
explanation.definitionFit: Classified columns in a newspaper are made up of short personal advertisements.

clue.text: Little Diana upset

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'Little Diana upset (7)', gives only DI and an indicator; the rest of the wordplay for SPUTE appears to be missing and no source gives the full clue.

clue.text: A player's longest and strongest attire from Savile Row

definitions.meaning: in card games, the suit in which a player holds most and best cards
a person's finest set of tailored clothes; Savile Row is the London street of bespoke tailors

explanation.surface: A card player's strongest holding and smart London tailoring.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both the strongest card holding in a hand and someone's finest outfit for occasions.

clue.text: Latest release has apparently become a recidivist!

definitions.meaning: a newly issued disc or single
a reoffender acquires a fresh entry on their criminal history

explanation.surface: A newly released criminal reoffends straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a newly issued disc and, humorously, a fresh criminal history entry.

clue.text: Post needed for a king's armour

definitions.meaning: the letters service, specifically Britain's national postal company
chain mail fit for a monarch

explanation.surface: Messages sent to a monarch requiring armour.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's postal service is named for the Crown, while mail is also chain armour, so a monarch's would be regal.

clue.text: Even it is reversible

indicators.note: says the word reads the same forwards and backwards, so the clue itself is the wordplay

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A remark that something flat can be turned over.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flat and smooth is even, with no bumps or slope.

clue.text: Personal claim staked by a prospector

definitions.meaning: the possessive word asserting ownership
a gold digger's claim is a pit dug for ore

explanation.surface: A gold prospector marks out the ground they say is theirs.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the first-person possessive and an excavation for minerals.

clue.text: Facial feature emphasised by a higher cheek

parts.note: upper means placed higher
lip is slang for insolence or cheek

explanation.surface: A face whose cheekbone is set higher stands out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cheek' looks like part of the face but means impudence here.
explanation.definitionFit: The top part of the mouth is a feature of the human face.

clue.text: Bury Pole in a concentration camp

definitions.note: the definition reads as a verb, to confine in a camp

parts.note: to inter is to bury a body
N is the north pole

explanation.surface: A Polish prisoner is buried in a wartime camp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' suggests a Polish person but is the magnetic pole N.
explanation.definitionFit: To intern is to confine prisoners or aliens in a camp during wartime.

clue.text: From Spain came his conqueror

indicators.note: the letters are taken from within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A ruler's conqueror arrived from Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'Spain came'; the whole clue also describes Pizarro's Spanish conquest of the Andean empire.
explanation.definitionFit: The Andean emperor was overthrown by the Spanish conquistador Pizarro.

clue.text: Common wife found in the Netherlands

definitions.meaning: Cockney slang 'my old dutch' means my wife
the people of Holland

explanation.surface: An ordinary spouse discovered in Holland.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the people of Holland, and 'dutch' is Cockney slang for a wife.

clue.text: It will signal Doomsday for the desperate bridge player

definitions.meaning: the trumpet blast heralding the Day of Judgement
the final trump card held in a hand

explanation.surface: A bridge player in trouble fears the end of the world.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical trumpet sounding Judgement Day shares its name with the final trump card in a bridge hand.

clue.text: Hoot in case a guard's van appears

indicators.note: one word sits inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
boo is a jeer, as is a hoot

explanation.surface: A railway guard's carriage turns up, prompting jeers.
explanation.walkthrough: A caboose is the American term; 'appears' is only a link joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: On American railways the crew car at the rear of a freight train is the counterpart of a British guard's van.

clue.text: Coming by road apparently

definitions.meaning: approaching or en route
literally travelling along a route

explanation.surface: Someone says they are travelling over by road.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means approaching and, taken literally, travelling along a route.

clue.text: Church House is run by a Euro-Conservative

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
EC is the European Community
Tory is the everyday name for a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A church building is managed by a pro-European right-winger.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman's official residence belonging to the parish is a church house.

clue.text: A simple brain makes for a clear conscience

definitions.meaning: literally, an uncomplicated intellect
a state of being untroubled by guilt

explanation.surface: Being simple-minded leaves one free of guilt.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally means an uncomplicated intellect, and idiomatically being free from worry or guilt.

clue.text: A note added to change Songs of Praise'

indicators.note: the first piece is attached to the front of the second

parts.note: PS is a postscript, a note added to a letter
to alter is to change

explanation.surface: A footnote is added to modify a hymn book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Songs of Praise' is a British TV hymn programme, but here means the biblical psalms.
explanation.definitionFit: A book of psalms contains sacred songs of worship.

clue.text: What a sempstress does when a godly man is impatient

parts.note: ST stands for saint, a holy person
someone who itches is restless and eager

explanation.surface: A seamstress at work alongside a restless holy man.
explanation.definitionFit: A seamstress sews, passing thread through fabric.

clue.text: He was supported by the Schutzstaffel

definitions.text: He was supported by the Schutzstaffel

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits above, held up by the second

parts.note: taken as written
SS is the abbreviation for the Nazi Schutzstaffel

explanation.surface: A Nazi leader backed by the SS.
explanation.walkthrough: Rudolf Hess, Hitler's deputy, was a Nazi leader who was indeed backed by the SS.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudolf Hess was deputy Führer of Nazi Germany.

clue.text: Oracular prophet returns to the body

indicators.note: says the name is read backwards

parts.note: Amos is an Old Testament prophet

explanation.surface: A biblical seer comes back to bodily form.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology the term denotes the physical body as distinct from the mind or germ cells.

clue.text: Raise the price when the pound comes under pressure

definitions.meaning: to increase a charge

definitions.text: when the pound comes under pressure
definitions.meaning: a weak pound means the German currency rises against it

explanation.surface: Prices go up when sterling weakens.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to increase a price; read as two words, the German currency rising.

clue.text: Small car park on the side of a hill

parts.note: taken as written
P is the sign for parking

explanation.surface: A compact car parked on a hillside.
explanation.definitionFit: A steep slope or escarpment forms the face of a hill.

clue.text: Vegetarian diet for ecologists

definitions.meaning: leafy vegetables
environmentalist campaigners or members of an environmental party

explanation.surface: Ecologists eating vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both leafy vegetables and environmentalist campaigners.

clue.text: A verse from Lear celebrated by the mouth of Shannon

definitions.meaning: Edward Lear popularised the five-line comic poem

definitions.text: celebrated by the mouth of Shannon
definitions.meaning: the Irish city on the Shannon estuary

explanation.surface: A poem by Edward Lear honoured at an Irish river.
explanation.definitionFit: The five-line comic poem shares its name with the Irish city and county on the Shannon.

clue.text: Slander contained in manuscript returned by auditor

indicators.note: says the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: an ear is the organ that hears, a listener

explanation.surface: Libel in a document sent back by an accountant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'auditor' suggests an accountant but means a listener here.
explanation.definitionFit: To defame is to spread damaging lies about someone.

clue.text: Take precautions by treating bone with a drug mixture

indicators.note: the words are worked on, made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Precautions taken by treating a bone with a drug compound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixture' adds to the anagram signal of 'treating'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being careful and watchful means guarding against danger.
